page_title: CEL 1-1 ALA | Celta Vigo v Alaves 28/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Luis Rioja (Alaves) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' That looked a certain handball by Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
90+4' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Antonio Blanco (Alaves). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.

90+3' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
90+2' Rafa Marin (Alaves) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+2' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:10.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
89' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
88' Samu (Alaves) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
85' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Javi Lopez and he is replaced by Ruben Duarte (Alaves).
85' The ball goes out for a corner. Alaves can continue in their attacking effort.
85' Samu (Alaves) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
85' A pass from Javi Lopez (Alaves) is intercepted by Ivan Villar and the move breaks down.
83' Samu (Alaves) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
82' A poorly taken free kick by Carles Perez (Celta Vigo)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
82' One of the Alaves players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Celta Vigo have a free kick from a promising distance.
78' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Javi Lopez (Alaves) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
75' Now Celta Vigo have a corner.
74' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jonathan Bamba will be replaced by Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo).
73' 1 - 1 Javi Lopez passes the ball into the penalty area. Samu (Alaves) collects it and quickly drills it into the roof of the net via the underside of the bar! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:1!
70' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' Luis Garcia Plaza prepares a substitution. Alex Sola is replaced by Xeber Alkain (Alaves).
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ianis Hagi departs the field of play to be replaced by Kike Garcia (Alaves).
69' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) gets a yellow card for protesting.
68' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.

64' What an opportunity! Ianis Hagi (Alaves) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
64' Ivan Villar makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Alex Sola (Alaves) after a cross from the side.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch for Iago Aspas.
63' Rafael Benitez decides to make a substitution. Fran Beltran will be replaced by Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo).
63' The manager makes a subsitution with Antonio Blanco (Alaves) coming on for Jon Guridi.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abderrahmane Rebbach leaves the pitch and Luis Rioja (Alaves) comes on.
61' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
61' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
60' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
60' Alaves get a corner.

59' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Ivan Villar to dive and make a save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
58' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Alaves.
56' Rafael Benitez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) replacing Jorgen Strand Larsen.
52' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
52' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
52' A pass from Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
50' Cesar Soto Grado interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ander Guevara (Alaves). Celta Vigo have been awarded a free kick.
48' The attendance is 16852.

47' Alex Sola (Alaves) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the right-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Ivan Villar, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
47' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
46' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) inside the box.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Cesar Soto Grado has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Alaves will take a corner kick.

45+2' Ivan Villar pulls off a fantastic save! Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the right post, but the effort is kept out. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
45+1' A great solo run by Alex Sola (Alaves) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Ivan Villar.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
42' Javi Lopez (Alaves) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
41' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
40' The current number of shots on goal is 0:3.
39' Alex Sola (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
36' Alaves take a short corner kick.

36' Javi Lopez (Alaves) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Alaves.
35' 1 - 0 Rafa Marin (Alaves) scores an unfortunate own goal and the opposition increase their lead!
34' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
33' Javi Lopez (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
31' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
31' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Celta Vigo have a corner.
28' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonio Sivera intercepts the ball.
27' Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
26' Looks like Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
26' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
26' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.
25' Alex Sola (Alaves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
24' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
21' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
21' Javi Lopez (Alaves) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
20' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo are awarded the free kick.
19' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
19' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
18' Ander Guevara (Alaves) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
17' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Alaves.
16' Rafa Marin (Alaves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Ivan Villar easily deals with the threat.
15' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.

14' Fine attempt! Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
12' The ratio of the ball possession is 75:25.

10' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will take a throw-in.
10' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
8' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Celta Vigo.

6' CHANCE! Jonathan Bamba finds Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Javi Lopez (Alaves).
4' Joseph Aidoo (Celta Vigo) sends a long ball forward to Iago Aspas, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
2' Samu (Alaves) unleashes a promising shot towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Ivan Villar thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
1' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Alaves will kick the game off.
